ACTORS\\ID-42*:
This was once a land of knowledge and meditation, of adoration of the Old Gods... but it is also the place where they were betrayed. Damn Zelos forever, there where his life drags on after death! It was he who called Her, who attracted her attention from the starry sky, and who guided Her to our world in exchange for eternal life and diabolical powers that make other mortals tremble. When we realised what was happening, it was too late. The Dark Lady had set out on her way and Zelos had fled from the Tower, or at least that's what we thought...
Desperate, we sought the help of the Ancients. They revealed to us how to call the White Goddess, the Stone of the Southeast, before leaving for places where the Northern Evil could not tarnish them.

But Zelos returned after his encounter with the darkness, stronger and thirsty for blood. I don't know how he got around our defences, but when we wanted to stop him his undead slaves had wiped out almost all of the inhabitants of the Tower. Few of us were able to escape eternal servitude, after serving as food for the new incarnation of the traitor...

ACTORS\\ID-53*:
Listen to me, you who does not seem to participate in the Evil that infects this part of the world. I was a renowned knight many centuries ago, and I always followed the Ailm Warriors' Code of Honour. When I learned of the shadow that covered this part of the world, I decided to finish it off, or perish trying...

But I wasn't well enough prepared. I never thought that I would find such evil here or anywhere. Ibur was cursed over a few days by a terrible Wizard with incredible powers, named Zelos. No one knew where this monster came from, but the peaceful citizens of Ibur were penned in like livestock to satisfy his blasphemous needs and, when the demon feeds himself, his hordes of soulless slaves grows and grows.

I couldn't help them! When they captured me, and I knew what my fate would be, I preferred to take my life with my own hand rather than obey Zelos for all eternity. But my soul cannot rest until someone annihilates this monster in his castle on the cliffs, and liberates the survivors of Ibur, blind and pale after centuries without light in the cells of this horrific place, forced to reproduce like cattle to guarantee food for a beast whose evil is surpassed only by that of the Dark Goddess of the North herself...

$0 Continue
ACTORS\\ID-54*:
Our life abroad does not make sense anymore. Because of our suffering and the darkness, most of us have gone crazy or lost our sense of sight. For centuries, some of our people have resorted to cannibalism as the only means of survival, turning themselves into something as shameful as our torturer, and those of us who managed to survive without disgracing ourselves, living on mushrooms and little insects, barely have the strength to walk. 

But now, at least, a hope glimmers for some of our children. Even so, everything will have been for nothing if Zelos finds out what has happened here and comes back for vengeance. You seem strong, and maybe you will have some chance against this monster. Take this and free us from him, or all our suffering will have been in vain! Some of our young would have liked to have used it to try to escape, but we are not experts with weapons, and our treasury would have fallen into the hands of the Evil Wizard.

ACTORS\\ID-57*:
Halt, you who seem to have a noble soul, and listen to what I have to say to you, because the future of mankind could depend on it.

I was one of the three heroes who defeated the Black Stone. My Goddess awarded me the most powerful sword; a weapon whose blade cannot be stopped by the most resistant armour or be dulled upon hitting the hardest metals. With it, along with an infallible bow and a magic sceptre, we should have been able to annihilate the demonic being forever. 
But something went wrong. The wizard did not do what was necessary in time, and the Goddess of the North was able to flee to some remote place, where she would wait for more propitious times, times that have already arrived, to the misfortune of all inhabitants of this era.

You need this sword to defeat her. Unfortunately, since the Evil was not destroyed but merely weakened, the effects of its actions did not disappear, and entire areas of the world continued to suffer endless horrors. The followers of the Stone of the North met in dark orders, and they continued to worship their Goddess in the shadows, when no one could see them. We heroes who survived the Great Wars did not enjoy our rest. There still remained much to do in many parts of the world.

A poisoned well was the cause of my death. And they took my sword to the North. Only a very strong person could use it to do evil and, even so, the blade would not release all of its energy. Find my sword and use it for what it was forged for! Show those damn demons what the will of men can achieve and then my spirit can rest in peace!

ITEMS\\ID-135: The New Circle of the Southwest
ITEMS\\ID-135*:
... and these mysterious monks have tricked My Lord with false promises of fame and power, and have brought disgrace to Fearn, the City of the Alders. Betraying his vows, My Lord has embraced the dark faith that they offered him, and has worshiped at this damned piece of black stone. May the hour when they completed the construction of this terrible circle that feeds this abominable stone be damned.
How much we have paid for his madness! The men of Fearn began to change quickly.  Monsters and tears have flooded the streets, and the few of us who have managed to avoid the corruption had to slip away by night to hide in these mines. Some of us have had to abandon our families to their fate...

But they have pursued us. From the woods to the south of the mountains more and more goblins, orcs and even some trolls arise. And the terrifying thing is that their faces are so familiar to us...
ITEMS\\ID-136*:
...Our Lady has known that her eternal enemy makes it possible for unworthy hands to violate her essence and transform her and guide the battle.
Her pride is hurt. She will never understand how someone of Her race could humble herself like this, being manipulated by such inferior beings.
But She senses great danger in this blasphemy and has determined to concede power to us to confront it.
Thus she gives us some pieces of Her flesh to create wonders we can use to destroy these heretics and some of them will be remembered with terror over the centuries to come...
ITEMS\\ID-137*: ...They were here before the arrival of the Stones. They were peaceful and loved all men. For this reason, when the darkness spread from the North, and sadness devoured mankind, they sadly departed to an unknown and remote place. But before they disappeared, the gave to Mankind some objects that would help them significantly in the battle against the Goddess of the North...
ITEMS\\ID-138*:
...it shines and is hot to the touch, since the
the magic of life fires it. It was one of the artefacts created by the Ancients before they abandoned man. It can sound three times and each time, all that is dead will return to dust whence it should have never arisen...
ITEMS\\ID-139*: ...and when a Great Wizard dies he must be buried according to the appropriate rites in the excavated mastabas to the North, along with his most sacred belongings. And his rest will be protected from intrusions with fearful spells...
ITEMS\\ID-140*: ...and the greatest of all of those wise men was, without a doubt, the Great Coll of Pethboc. His skills were without equal and he manufactured magical objects that rivalled the creations of the Ancients themselves. Most notable among them is a simple silver medallion whose power protects whoever carries it from most of the damage caused by arrows and weapons. It is like wearing strong armour, but without any weight...
ITEMS\\ID-141*:
By the order of Eadha, Lord of Ailm, you are entrusted with the destruction of any human settlement that has survived in these hills. Our new allies want this land to be free of indiscreet eyes in order to construct a new temple to the Lady of Darkness, a temple where the energies that will turn Ailm into an invincible kingdom of conquerors will be released. Use the fortress as a base for the new objectives.
Likewise you must eliminate any Amazon that you find in our territories. Soon, all of the woods will belong to the dominions of Ailm and will provide us with the wood and hunting necessary for the conquest of all the kingdoms farther South.
ITEMS\\ID-142*:
...in the high Ur Mountain the Lords of the Kingdoms that are still free met, and swore their allegiance against the hordes of the blasphemous Cult of the North. There, among the shining remains of the White Goddess, they doled her legacy out exactly as she determined they were to do. The chosen ones advanced and took weapons and armour, and a shining light enveloped them as they did so.

But many of these new stars were snuffed in the battles that followed that conclave. Many princes and kings, many heroes and wizards fell to the black forces unleashed by the Dark Priests in the conflict. Rivers of blood and tears were spilled before the forces of evil were forced to withdraw. 
Many of the Goddess' gifts were captured and corrupted by sacrilegious hands. 

Fortunately, the strongest, those that were forged with the largest part of her essence, could not be contaminated even when they were captured, and will never serve the designs of those wretches...
ITEMS\\ID-143*:
...it was not always dark and stinking, nor was it
plagued by these abominable monsters called trolls. 
On the contrary, it was for decades a fertile land where abundant crops were gathered. Its inhabitants met in a village that probably has been overtaken by weeds. It is said that one of them brought about the ruin, bringing to this place a fragment of the black stone given to him by a stranger, promising that it would protect the fields from ice and hail, and that the villagers would become strong and resistant.

The fall of the Dark Lady did not bring about the reversal of the curse, which suggests that the damned fragment still maintains its power. Many heroes have disappeared trying to find it. The trolls are very dangerous beings and, even without them, the area is deadly...
ITEMS\\ID-144*:
The Wizard was the guilty one. It was he who wavered, who let the Goddess hide herself. His fatal doubt at the most inopportune moment meant the failure of years of pain and war. 

And even though he repented, even though he was able to expel her from his spirit, it is his fault that all of Mankind will suffer for centuries to come, since the evil Goddess of the North will one day be able to rise from the tomb where she sleeps and waits, protected by her faithful, to return to devastate the cities of men with abominations not even dreamed of by the human soul.

This is why the lineage of the Wizard will carry the stigma for generations, a stigma of evil that will affect all of his descendants until one of them, confronting the Lady of Evil again, manages to defeat her or sing her praises for all eternity. 
When this moment arrives, the future of Mankind will depend on the choice of one lone mortal, a choice that will make the difference between a destiny constructed by man for himself, or a destiny worse than extinction.
ITEMS\\ID-145*:
...many centuries had to pass before human beings risked the return to the cold northern lands. But, little by little, the memory of the terror that they dwelled in weakened in the minds of the tribes and some, the bravest, dared to adventure into these uninhabited territories. 
Some clans found virgin woods and mountains ripe for hunting, endless meadows and clean rivers populated by salmon and trout, and soon with these riches they began to prosper. The first settlements were not long in coming, and these would become cities and later, capitals of powerful kingdoms.

And of all of these, the most feared was always the kingdom of Cuileann, which dominated the lands situated further to the North, those that border the Sea of Ice and Mists, from which no one has ever returned. This kingdom rises up over the ashes of what was once the centre of the empire ruled over by the acolytes of the Dark Goddess. In fact, there are voices that warn that a great danger will rise up out of the forests of this kingdom since, in some remote place, among the frozen shadows of the old trees, the remains of the Enemy of Mankind must lie...
ITEMS\\ID-146*:
...and the first kingdom that disappeared under the cloak of the Dark Goddess of the North was that of Ibur, way off in the far east of the known lands, to the north of the forests above Ailm. 

The City of Ibur darkened in only one day, a little before the great impact, and no one ever returned from it again. But the fate of Ibur was forgotten in very little time, because soon the Lady of he North descended over our world, and the thoughts of human beings were to abandon Ibur to its fate.

When the hordes of the North fell, and their Goddess was defeated, many heroes thought that the moment had arrived to deal with the evil that affected the ancient city, or to see if it had disappeared as had so many others. But none of those who headed off for that place ever returned from the city. Even one of the great heroes in the defeat of the Black Stone disappeared there. Not even the ships that tried to pass it by sea to get to the villages situated further East ever returned from their journeys. Some of those that neared it but did not have the courage to continue affirm that, on clear days, you can see a castle situated above the cliff rocks to the southeast of the city, a castle that no one, not even the most ancient books, mentions or remembers.
ITEMS\\ID-147*:
... and the servants of the rock of the North discovered a simple method to spread the plague that had transformed them. Guided by their Lady, they took fragments of Her and they sowed them throughout the world, surrounding them with circles of rocks carved with magical symbols that extended their awful power. In the areas around these blasphemous circles, their influence was soon felt: the humans who dwelled near them were transformed into horrible physical and mental monsters who attacked their neighbours in order to bring them to the circle and increase the number of the damned. Then, the sickness spread further and further from the fragment, like a plague that feeds itself on the energies of the affected.

Destroying this fragment will not bring back humanity to the affected, but it will detain the advance of the evil.  It appears that only when the Goddess is annihilated will those turned into monsters be given a cure...
ITEMS\\ID-148*: ...and the last artefact forged with the spirit of the White Goddess was the strongest of all. It was known as the Sceptre of Destiny, and it consumed what little energy remained in Our Benefactress as she fed its interior. Its capacities are many, and it is the definitive weapon if a wizard of superior ability and clean spirit handles it. It was about to finish off the Stone of the North forever, but the wizard who brandished it did not display the proper dignity for such a task, and his doubts brought about the flight of The Evil One before she could be completely destroyed...
ITEMS\\ID-149*:
...May God damn the ancients and the benign Goddess who has showed them how to invoke these stupid mortals! If it weren't for them, my plans would be completed and in a little while, the Dark Lady would be little more than my servant...

I had everything so well thought out! I had figured out how to trick her and convince her that she should hand over a piece of her black being to me,... I knew how to use it to forge something that even She did not know could exist. My years of study in the libraries of the Tower of Uath had borne fruit, after many tricks played on the credulous wizards who thought they were my mentors. In the book where they speak of Her, the book that I later destroyed, The Cauldron was also mentioned...

My powers as a wizard are not unlimited. I don't know why, but not all of the undead servants accept an eternal existence. And in the spell book it warned me; it seems that the evil that animates them requires the spirit of the dead man, in a way that if it was not very malignant during the lifetime, tends to dissolve and destroy it within only a few months, leaving it incapable of movement.

With the Cauldron it was different. It was enough to put the corpse inside to make it ten times stronger than it was when it breathed, obedient to the point of total destruction and eternal in its absence of life. With it, my power would have been increasing infinitely. My army would have been completely unstoppable even to the followers of the Goddess and in a little time She herself would have had to pay respect to me if she did not want to be destroyed.

But I had not calculated on the interference of the White Stone. Its heroes managed to destroy my undead soldiers before their number became sufficient, and they may well have finished off with me if I had not been able to flee to Certhann. There I left my cauldron, there lie my dreams of divinity...

Now I posses no power to make my dominions advance and return to them. On the road, the place where the White Goddess fell stands in the way and I can not get through it. And to go around it requires a path too long for my weak slaves. I must wait for the return of the Black Stone to once again have this support and get back what belongs to me...
ITEMS\\ID-150*:
...it was on this mountain that The Lady of the Light fell. There she lay hidden until her Sister began her evil work. There she was sacrificed and her essence handed over so that mankind could survive...
As a consequence, this peak remains impregnable in its sanctity. Nothing impure can survive where She spoke to the men, and the more diabolical a being is, the less chance that it can near the sacred mountain. In the case of some leaders of the cult of the Rock of the North, not even they can near its hillsides without their own evil consuming them...
ITEMS\\ID-151*:
...You will use the slaves to carry out any work, however hard it may be, without worrying about whether they lose their lives. When they grow old or become crippled, you will send them to Our Lady of the Darkness, so that she can turn them into monsters to serve as shock troops. Orcs, goblins and undead will fight in the frontlines, stirring terror and wreaking havoc among the populations of humans with their lack of ridiculous sentiment.

Above the monsters and the contract mercenaries will always be the Acolytes of the Goddess. Schooled to give their lives for their Lady, these sectarians are terrifying warriors, who know neither pity nor fear of the enemy. The organisation has a military essence, thus the priests will possess the power of life and death over the faithful and over those chosen to be apprentices. The prize for good service will be a higher position in the table of ranks. The punishment for failure will be death, and the corpse will be used for whatever ends the priests wish. It is lawful to try to ascend through the defeat of an immediate superior, who remains at the disposal of the conqueror. The highest position in the order is the Great General, a military as well as a spiritual leader of our sacred cult.

But above any member of the Order we Guardian Wizards of the Goddess always keep watch. We will never abandon her, and for that reason it is rare to see us in the land of mortals. Our power to do magic is immense: we control energies capable of taking down an army. We are only accountable to the Goddess or to her incarnation, and this is why any other servant must pay respects to us...
ITEMS\\ID-152*:
...The conjunction is nearing. The moment that we have so yearned for has arrived, the moment when our Lady must wake up from her century-long lethargy. Our vengeance will be terrifying, and the unfaithful will not be able to remember it for centuries because no one will remain to do so.

But, in this delicate moment, we must be exceedingly cautious. The Lady of the Darkness cannot arise by herself, such was the damage that was inflicted upon her by those damned ones whose punishment will be horrific and eternal. We need a creature to lend its body for the advent, an innocent being, easy to convince and incapable of resisting. 

Fortunately, we have this being. Our Sister Superior has been conveniently educating the princess of Cuileann, who will serve our purposes perfectly...
MAPAS\\ID-1:
The Mines of Nion

No ship now sets sail from the Port of Beth. The seas have become very dangerous, and the fleet prefers to remain moored. The only possible route out of the mercenary tribe settlement that rules Beth, the Massif of Nion, is in the South, where the tall mountains are rife with danger. Few are brave enough to dare to take it on.
The old ones say that the peaks can be crossed from below, through the corridors of a few old mines abandoned long ago...


$Objective: Get through the Mines and find the parchment of the "New Circle of the Southwest".
MAPAS\\ID-10:
The Forest of Onn Outskirts

Goblin patrols are pestering the villages where Amazons and forest archers of Onn live. From time to time, a troll taken from the nearby woods helps them. Everything seems to indicate that they are nothing less than scouts from a nearby army that will not be long in attacking...


$Objective: Clear the forest foothills of goblins.
MAPAS\\ID-11:
The Abandoned Encampment

These wooded hills form a lightly inhabited territory. 
 The Amazons of the Onn forest do not like strangers, and do not make the survival of the settlers easy. Further, the woods of the trolls are not very far and these creatures venture out around these places every once in a while, greatly undermining its security. Once, the Knights of the Kingdom of Ailm watched over the inhabitants, and even raised a fortress that served as a base from which to patrol the area better. But, not long ago, the Lord of Ailm ordered the retreat of his men for no reason and the settlers had to move to more secure lands...


$Objective: Disrupt Lord Ailm's plans, destroying the patrols of traitorous knights sent to the forest.
MAPAS\\ID-12:
The Forest of Dair

The vegetation here is spiny and twisted. The water stagnates in stinking pools infected with insects and other poisonous animals. And worse, it is said that entire families of trolls inhabit these parts. Any human with a sense of dignity would hate these smelly creatures!

They also say that the ruins of a very old and prosperous villager hold some treasures and objects of interest...


$Objective: Destroy the Fragment of the Dark Goddess that corrupts this site.
MAPAS\\ID-13:
The Dominions of Ailm

A rich and strong country, whose governors have always been respected and loved, this was the Kingdom of Ailm until now. But its latest lord has begun to change, and not for the good. It seems that periods of want reveal the true character of a man, and the character of their leaders, in many cases, does not respond to the expectations that are generated around them.

The people of Ailm no longer love their king, but they fear him too much to help a stranger. The actions of the knights of Ailm show clearly that this country does not fight for the good for mankind. Its renegade armies must be crushed, now that they continue to organise...


$Objective: Liberate the people of Ailm from the tyranny and excesses of the renegade knights, expelling them from these lands.
MAPAS\\ID-14:
The City of Ailm

The streets of Ailm lack the joy that they always displayed. Since the king began making deals with the northern messengers, the citizens have not done anything more than suffer new and unjust laws.  It has become obvious that the intentions of the Lord of this city are not as praiseworthy as they should be. Somebody needs to stop him...


$Objective: Take the life of the corrupt Lord of Ailm.
MAPAS\\ID-15:
The Woods to the East of the Inn of the White Goddess

These woods are very rarely visited, given that they hold nothing that would attract the attention of an adventurer, and it is a territory that is too dangerous for settlers. To the northeast the damned city of Ibur can be found, feared even by the most renowned warriors, and from which no one returns.

The armies of Ailm have never ventured this far north, since the forest is so dense and old that it is very difficult to maintain fortified positions that can communicate with the outside world. It is an ancient area and the evils that infest it have resided there for a long time...


$Objective: Get through the area safe and sound.
MAPAS\\ID-16:
The Inn of the White Goddess.

A land of peace in the midst of an ocean of war. Like an oasis in the worst of deserts. These are the words usually used to describe this inn, well-known in all inhabited lands. 

Always full of warriors, adventurers and soldiers who are looking for a little tranquillity and fun in their strained lives, the Inn of the White Goddess can almost instantly gather a defensive army of the most diverse populations if some crazy person tries to attack it. Even the bitterest enemies will forget their differences and join forces until the inn is saved.

Moreover, the innkeeper who runs it is a rich man who has his own group of guards, charged with preventing disorder in the place and recruited from the most capable swordsmen and fighters of known kingdoms.

If you are looking for a calm drink, a little entertainment, and, why not, a little information, you have come to the right place.


$Objectives: Get to know the people in this place and do some wheeling and dealing with the salespeople and wizards to improve your equipment supply.
MAPAS\\ID-17:
The Woods to the West of the Inn of the White Goddess

One of the reasons that the Inn of the White Goddess is so rarely attacked is its excellent position. Dangers usually come from the northeast, and on this side, the inn is isolated by some very thick and intricate forests. 

Usually, the only inhabitants of these woods are the deer, birds and wild boar that fill the inn's pantries, along with some wolves who pester them during the cold seasons. 

But lately other less native creatures have appeared in them, creatures that could endanger the steady stream of business. Orcs and undead have been seen in the outskirts of the woods and, while they appear to be fighting among themselves for now, they could soon agree to come together to attack other much more convenient prey. Maybe someone should clear this area and assure the tranquillity of the faithful clientele of the White Goddess...


$Objective: Get rid of the monsters gathering in the woods before they can attack the Inn of the White Goddess.
MAPAS\\ID-18:
The Woods to the North of the Inn of the White Goddess

Rumours indicate that in the thick of these woods an Orc military encampment has been set up. It is a strange place, far from human cities and from any other target for their attacks. They could be planning to attack the Inn of the White Goddess, but they are still not strong enough to assure a victory so complex, so surely they are looking for something else. What could their objective be? Not even they would dare to go near damned Ibur, and the high summit of Ochtach is the only thing to the north. Its yearlong snows spark almost the same terror in the souls of men as Ibur...


$Objective: Defeat the Orc General.
MAPAS\\ID-19:
The Lands of Ibur

Many are the legends that speak of Ibur as the most horrific place in the known world. In truth, no one, not even the most famous heroes, has ever returned from its dark, silent streets. There is talk of a very powerful evil connected to a castle that rises up on the other side of the city, on the cliffs at the extreme east of the world. 

What is known is that hordes of the Undead guard over these lands, and the punishment inflicted on the rash person who tries to cross them is a sudden and horrible death. Up to now, they have not crossed the lines that mark their dominions, the old borders of Ibur, but perhaps they will change their minds soon, now that the Evil extends its cloak from the far north again. Someone must make sure that this threat does not become a reality...


$Objective: Cross through the area, heading to Ibur to find out the fate of the city.
MAPAS\\ID-2:
The Woods to the North of Fearn

In the distance it is possible to make out some proud buildings: The until recently bustling city of Fearn. But, to get there, you must cross through a thick forest. And the howls and groans that you can hear in its interior do not seem to belong to any creature created by nature...


$Objective: Bring back peace to the forest, wiping out all the monsters that have invaded it.
MAPAS\\ID-20:
The City of Ibur

Centuries ago, this was a prosperous and populous city. Now it is nothing more than a bastion that defends the pass to the fortress of a soulless monster. Its streets boil with hungry Undead whose existence only has one objective: Obey their lord, Zelos, the demonical wizard whose origin is lost in the beginning of the centuries. 
Ibur must be cleansed! Its inhabitants are anxious to find a peace that is prohibited to them. The destruction of these miserable wretches is a duty for any combatant with a minimum of pity who pretends to know the meaning of the word honour...


$Objective: Free the castle from the horrors that populate it -skeletons and zombies.
MAPAS\\ID-21:
The Caves of Aball

To the North of Ibur lies a small mountain burrowed through by many caves. These caves are quite beautiful, and before Ibur fell victim to evil, many travellers visited them at the end of the year.

But the aesthetic sense of Zelos in his new incarnation is not that of the average mortal. The only thing that the monster saw in the beauty of those caverns was a place where human livestock could be easily guarded. To free these wretches, condemned to a horrific existence and slavery after death, is an unavoidable duty for any person who calls himself human...


$Objective: Find the exit from the caves.
MAPAS\\ID-22:
The Castle of Zelos

It rises in front of you, impressive in its evilness, its architecture twisted like the mind of its inhabitant. Waves beat forcefully against the cliffs, many meters below its ramparts, and lightening bolts illuminate its dark towers that rise up sharply, pointed to wound the skies. There is nothing to say. Eliminate the evil demon that brought the worst nightmare upon the world only to make of himself a repugnant bloodsucker!


$Objective: Destroy the damned monster that brought this horror upon the world. Death to Zelos!
MAPAS\\ID-23:
The Grasslands of Sceith

The School of Magic of Sceith has always been a peaceful place dedicated to meditation and study. Heir to the knowledge and learning rescued from Uath, it brings together the wisdom of almost all of the kingdoms of the known lands. But lately its peace has been disturbed. Small groups of zombies are wreaking havoc in the areas surrounding the school. The grasslands to the south of the building are no longer secure, and it wouldn't be a bad thing for someone to bring back calm to these lands...


$Objective: Assure the tranquility of the School of magic of Sceith, emptying the grasslands of the monsters that threaten it.
MAPAS\\ID-24:
The Forest to the South of Sceith

The hordes of undead that until now have been kept behind the borders of Ibur have begun their advance on other territories, and Sceith is the closest.  Zombies and skeletons sweep the area, their number growing as they eradicate life in their path.  If they are not stopped, soon the school of magic, and the entire state of Sceith will find itself with serious problems



$Objective: Decimate the army of the undead that has infected the castle and find the exit.
MAPAS\\ID-25:
The Holy Summit of Ochtach

Always snow-covered, the peak of Ochtach is the most imposing mountain in all of the known kingdoms. Not even the high northern mountains can overshadow it. Moreover, Ochtach has always been encircled by a halo of mystery that makes it even more respected. No one has ever had a bad encounter on the mountain, but legends insist on strange lights and noises that disturb the night of the lost traveller.

It is said that this is where the Great Goddess of Good came down, and that here the heroes of all the land met to each receive a weapon and a destiny. It is possible that so much magic, so much beneficent energy can be released here that the ghosts of that encounter can still be seen...

But now some orcs are meeting on the hillsides. Something seems to be stopping them from reaching the summit, but every day that passes they grow stronger and more daring. This is a holy mountain and represents all the good that ennobles mankind. It must be cleansed of these parasites!


$Objective: Discover the secret that the Holy Summit of Ochtach hides.
MAPAS\\ID-26:
The Ruins of Caerthann

In the old days Caerthann was a city of great beauty, famous for its dedication to culture and the arts. It used to boast that there were muses in the peak of Ochtach, who blessed its inhabitants with the gifts necessary to create unparalleled works of art in the fields of sculpture, architecture and engineering. Then the Stones fell and Caerthann found itself right on the line that marked the positions of the two impacts. 

It is said that the Goddess of the North sent one of her most demonic servants to lay waste to the city. Caerthann was the second, after Ibur, to suffer limitless perversions and cruelties. Some of its inhabitants were able to flee, among them, a young blacksmith who would find on Octhach the site of the White Goddess, the hope of all mankind.

But the city remained in the hands of the servants of the darkness and many weapons that were found to cause irreparable damage to human armies were tried out there. Some of them remained among the rubble and the silence when it was reconquered, since the air had been so polluted that no one could remain there for much time, and many undiscovered secret recesses remain...


$Objective: Destroy the Cauldron of Damnation, Zelos' horrific creation, forever.
MAPAS\\ID-27:
The Great Encampment

These thick woods are the first natural walls of defence for the north against undesired incursions. Their beauty is only comparable to their expanse. For centuries, they have been governed by the wills of bears and great grey wolves.  Now the main body of the Northern Army rests among the trees, waiting for the order to advance and devastate the southern kingdoms. Very strong heroes will be needed to stop this enormous deployment of troops...


$Objective: Smash the army gathered in the Great Encampment, impeding their ability to advance to the South.
MAPAS\\ID-28:
To the West of the Fortress of Draidean

The forest here is disagreeable and inhospitable. The low temperatures allow only for the survival of the strongest and most resistant species. There is no room for colour or for beautiful forms. Further north the second wall that defends the far north from undesired incursions rises: The terrible Massif of Crithach, with its frozen summits and peaks. The only known pass is through the Fortress of Draidean, where the Great General of the army of shadows orders the destruction of the human world. Perhaps passes through the hidden caves still exist, to find out, you will have to go there.

But the Northern Power has not left this route unguarded. The smoke of small campfires reveals that henchmen of the Black Stone are charged with cutting off this pass. Finding yourself now so close to your destiny, it would be odd if these troops did not turn out to be dangerous...


$Objective: Get through the area safe and sound.
MAPAS\\ID-29:
To the East of the Fortress of Draidean

A narrow corridor of land, flanked by the forest to the west and the sea to the east, it leads to the city of Cuileann, capital of the Ice Empire. It is from there that the evil will arrive again, according to the predictions of seers and soothsayers of many kingdoms, and they may be right.

Neither a messenger nor a Cuileann merchant has been seen since the orcs and the undead came down from the woods. The fate of this city, so close to the ancient Empire of the Stone, cannot have been very promising. Perhaps they need help. But to reach this point you must cross the terrain where you find yourself, and it will not be easy, because it is plagued with acolytes of the Goddess of the North, ready to sacrifice themselves for her...


$Objective: Get through the labyrinth.
MAPAS\\ID-3:
The Mountains to the Northeast of Fearn

To the north and the south far-off constructions can be made out. To arrive there, you have to walk for a long time over difficult paths sown with evil. What's more, the hordes of orcs are strong there, as if they were gathering to form an army. It won't be a good thing for mankind if they are able to organise...


$Objectives: Disperse and destroy the groups of goblins and orcs who are gathering so that they cannot organise themselves into armies (limited time).
MAPAS\\ID-30:
The Fortress of Draidean

Until recently, this place was only an ice-covered ruin of legends, which nobody dared to near. But now, reconstructed by slaves of Cuileann, its imposing aspect makes a future of death and conquests certain. Walls, moats and fortified battlements make Draidean an impregnable bastion, from whose porticoes armies will be able to burst forth in crazed adoration of the Stone. Somewhere inside, the Great General of the Northern armies damns entire kingdoms with his orders. And at his side hangs a Sword that he should not possess, a Sword whose purpose has been twisted and violated. It is your duty to get it back. With the Sword in hand, few could resist your advance...


$Objective: Take the life of the Great General of the armies of the Goddess.
MAPAS\\ID-31:
The East of the Massif of Crithach

This is the loftiest area of these impassable mountains. But behind it hides the Enemy of Mankind. This pass will surely be well defended. But if you have got this far, you are not going to let anyone hold you back...


$Objective: Explore the mountains and eliminate the Dark Wizards.
MAPAS\\ID-32:
The West of the Massif of Crithach

The lowest part of these feared mountains does not lead to the place where the Black Stone struck, but it does guard the route to Cuileann. Before you attempt to finally complete your mission, it would be convenient for you to try to discover what happened to this once proud city. On the other hand, as you know, She is waiting for you...


$Objective: Cross through the region to Cuileann to discover the destiny of the Northern City.
MAPAS\\ID-33:
The Burial Mounds of Fincoll

During the Great Wars that were fought centuries ago, thousands of combatants died. When victory finally smiled upon the human army, the survivors did not forget those who had given their lives for them. In the plain of Fincoll, to the south of Cuileann, burial mounds were raised where these heroes could rest with great honour.

But with the arrival of the darkness, the purpose of Fincoll was horribly distorted. The servants of the Black Goddess saw this cemetery only as a warehouse of cadavers to use for their own ends. Liberating these proud warriors from their unbearable yoke after death is a duty for all mankind...


$Objective: Return the inhabitants of the Burial Mounds to their dark tombs, eliminating the wizards who disturb their peace.
MAPAS\\ID-34:
The City of Cuileann

The capital of the entire Northern Empire, this proud city has fallen into the hands of the blasphemous cult of the Black Stone. Its inhabitants have been sacrificed or work like slaves waiting for an even worse fate. 

The king and his servants were the first to disappear. Only the little princess remained, but her actions have been worthy of the greatest of the demons; there is little doubt that something horrible possesses her. Her nursemaid, a terrible witch hated by the few human beings who remain in the city, has adopted the role of the ancient and beloved Great Chamberlain, and has taken on executing all of her evil mistress' order, bringing fear and destruction to all the corners of the kingdom.

There is nothing to do for this poor girl except liberate her from the horrendous parasite that has eaten her up...


$Objective: Discover the fate of the Princess Naya.
MAPAS\\ID-35:
The Temple of the Black Goddess

You already know what your duty is. In some nearby place hides the plague that has battered mankind for uncountable years. The ultimate confrontation is about to begin...

$Objective: Destroy the Dark Goddess and all of her protectors.
MAPAS\\ID-4:
The Palace of Fearn

The star of the city of Fearn has shone prosperously and proudly for many years. But recently, shadows have covered it. Above the open arch of her doors lies a great stone shield that represents a beautiful alder tree in flower. But this symbol of resurrection has not been able to help the city's unfortunate inhabitants.

Evil eyes watch you from the blackness, and you sense a perverse intelligence that is very powerful in the heart of the ruins. Someone - or something - is waiting for you...


$Objectives: Find the Lord of Fearn and capture the key to the Tower of Uath.
MAPAS\\ID-5:
The Tower of Uath

It has come to be said this tower predates the War of the Two Stones. It seems incredible that not only is it still erect, but that it doesn't show any signs of ruin. The magic that protects it must be incredibly powerful.

Herds of beasts and goblins circle it, looking for a way to enter. Its walls must hold formidable secrets that cannot fall into the wrong hands...


$Objective: Get the Scepter of Destiny.
MAPAS\\ID-6:
The Mastabas of Tinne

You find yourself in the Mastabas of Tinne. Lately, goblin patrols have been combing the area looking for something... You don't know exactly what they hope to find, but it would be best if you find it before they do.


$Objective: Empower the Medallion of Coll.
MAPAS\\ID-7:
The West of the Lands of Gort

This is the place from which life fled so long ago. It is said that this was where the decisive battle against the northern hordes was fought, and that the forces that they confronted devastated these lands forever. However, it seems that there is movement upon these hard lands. Creatures who were not seen so far south for many years are organising for their dark purposes...


$Objective: Get through the area safe and sound.
MAPAS\\ID-8:
The Orc Encampment

Much activity rules over this area. Many Orcs have camped here, strengthening themselves for new attacks. No kingdom will be safe while this encampment continues here, its numbers swelling...


$Objectives: Destroy the Orc Encampment, eliminating its leader.
MAPAS\\ID-9:
The Eastern of the Lands of Gort

Here the entire territory has not been taken, as happened further west. But neither are these lands free from the corruption that advances from the north. Hordes of monsters criss-cross the area to group in other places, throwing themselves into pillaging and assassination. The villages, probably, would be thankful if someone would make their roads safe again...


$Objectives: Expel the monsters from these lands, so that the villagers can live in peace again.
V3\\DescBarbaro: Since you were born into the bosom of your tribe, you have been educated in the art of war and the strict code of the mercenary.  A job undone is a dishonour not only for you, but also for your entire line.  Death in combat is preferable to stepping away from a commitment, for the word of a mercenary is sacred and sufficient to seal any contract.  You have always carried out your duty, like all in your clan, and this pride gives meaning to your life.  However, during the last few weeks, you have not been able to sleep at night because of the dreams.  Someone among your ancestors is not resting in peace.  He could not complete an important task when everyone was trusting in him, although it was not his fault.  Through the mists, you see a place covered with rocks. A barbarian, who looks just like you, fighting with impressive armour and a resplendent axe.  Your destiny is decided.  After a few words with the shaman of your tribe, you begin your journey.  Somehow, you know that you must find your ancestor's weapons and finish what he began in order to clear his name and the name of your family and your tribe.  Too many evil creatures have been roaming around the known lands lately, but this is not going to stop you
V3\\DescAmazon: Your entire life has taken place in the tranquillity of the woods.  You love its greenness and peacefulness more than anything else in the world.  In your hidden hamlet in the thickest part of the grove, you have been educated to defend the innocence and sanctity of nature however you can.  You do not hate strangers, but they are not well received.  And if they damage the forest for no good reason, they are attacked and expelled without mercy.  But the nights are not as peaceful as they once were.  Goblins and even worse monsters have been seen a little too close lately.  Something very powerful threatens not only your forest, but all of the forests and the entirety of the known lands.  Something that must be stopped before it is too late.  You alone have dreamt of the magic bow and deep inside, you know that you must leave.  In your dreams you have also seen comrades in combat to be met and a rocky land to be purified.  It hurts you to abandon all that you know, but it also excites your curiosity to learn about new places and you feel the thirst for adventure
V3\\DescHechicera: You do not know where you come from, but this does not matter to you.  You were taken by Ariran, your mentor, when you were very little and since then you have been brought up and educated in the magic arts.  You live in his tower along with the other acolytes, and you pass your days dedicated to study.  You have worked hard to please your mentor and have almost achieved that.  However, something darkens the horizon when he talks to you, something that only he can see.  You have turned into someone powerful, but he does not seem pleased.  He confesses that he sees a stain inside of you, something far off, that comes from your ancestors and could drag your soul into the darkness.  He does not know how, but you must eradicate this stain, which has been growing lately along with the evil outside.  He advises that you travel in search of an answer, which is probably related to your ancestors.  It does not seem like a bad idea.  During the last few nights you have dreamt of adventures, combat, comrades and magical artefacts that have great powers.  Perhaps there is a premonition in these dreams.  If not, you can achieve so much power in the world that Ariran will have no choice but to be proud of you.  The tower is becoming a little too narrow

INTRO\\1: Man was hardly considered man when the stars aligned and the great stones fell from the sky. As they fell, they fell apart - as if repelling each other during their rapid descent.
INTRO\\2: It would seem to the believer now, that these stones had felt hatred towards each other; and that since the beginning of time, this hatred had been welling up inside them ...
INTRO\\3: Many centuries passed and the legends were forgotten until one day a wandering nomad tribe, travelling north, came to dwell close by.
INTRO\\4: The large stones were now long buried, but their magic pulsated through the veins of the earth, their lure unfortunately too powerful for mortal man...
INTRO\\5: As it happened the great black stone, or "Nightstone" as it's now known - fell in the North.  Its malevolence blinded those who lived here and soon large rock circles were erected to increase its evil power.
INTRO\\6: Some of the followers without notice became repulsive hideous creatures and their numbers swarmed with evil seed..
INTRO\\7: The Nightstone allowed them to use its materials to construct many powerful items including weapons, strong armour and magic spells. Other slaves, under the evil influence were called to lead great armies in order to spread it's evil intent and to eliminate those who denied it's power.  Many, many years of darkness continued...
INTRO\\8: As fate decided, the other stone, a stone of pure goodness fell in the Southeast.  It too lay hidden for a while until a small band of travellers on the run from these wars, came to live nearby.  These were a skilled and happy people and soon the calming influence of the great White stone became them.
INTRO\\9: This stone also encouraged these people to use its precious materials, but use it of their own free will! - to construct powerful weapons and armour to fight the dark armies with.  It also taught them the ways of positive magic.
INTRO\\10: Many bloody battles were fought, but from this chaos and turmoil, our three heroes came.  They became masters of their chosen art and fought only for the causes of good.
INTRO\\11: History would later dictate that the evil was eventually beaten and the Nightstone army defeated, but the stone itself was not destroyed.
INTRO\\12: Our heroes for their deeds were granted immortality by the great White stone and swore an oath to protect over it for the rest of time.
INTRO\\13: Recently, however, there have been whispers and rumours that the alignment once again is near and that the evil would return, no-one really showed any interest in this until one night princess Naya left the grounds of her father's palace and did not return home.
INTRO\\14: When the King's knights eventually found her, deep in the forest, she was silent and her eyes shone with an intense dark light that both scared them and welcomed them in an instant.
INTRO\\15: It is now time to summon our three guardians and try to expand the spirit of the great White stone once more. Maybe this time, they will succeed in destroying the evil Nightstone once and for all...
